You no longer need to manually describe which DOM element you want to modify; just click on it in the browser, write down the notes for the expected operation, and your AI tool will automatically receive the complete element context—CSS, selectors, component information, etc.—to execute the code modification. Say goodbye to manual copy-pasting, screenshot annotations, and blind guessing of selectors.
projects.originalDescription: DOM Pointer MCP 弥合了浏览器与 AI 编码工具之间的鸿沟。你无需再手动描述想要修改哪个 DOM 元素，只需在浏览器中点击它，写下你期望操作的备注，你的 AI 工具便会自动接收完整的元素上下文——CSS、选择器、组件信息等——从而执行代码修改。告别手动复制粘贴、告别截图标注、告别盲猜选择器。
